title: Ryan OS Bid Turnover Intake
description: The structured reading of one inbound Outlook bid request. Every field is optional except builder_name/from_email and project - the engine is designed to produce a usable turnover email from very little. Fill in what the email actually says; do not invent values. Unknowns become governed defaults with a confidence level, which is the correct behavior.

received_at.description: ISO timestamp the request landed in Outlook.

builder_name.description: Builder or company name as written in the email.

from_email.description: Sender address. The domain is the strongest Builder Library match signal - always include it.

customer_type.description: homeowner_direct = a homeowner or one-time direct customer, not a builder account.

project.description: Address, lot, or project name. Goes in the subject line.

project_type.description: Anything other than new construction triggers a scope review escalation.

jurisdiction.description: City or county, if stated. Drives the permit confidence level.

stories.description: Story count. Feeds the one-system-per-floor default. Null is fine - it just lowers confidence.

conditioned_sqft.description: Also used as a production-vs-custom signal for new builders.

email_body.description: Paste the builder's message. The engine scans it for rush language, out-of-scope keywords, and explicit system counts.

attachments.description: Attachment filenames exactly as they appear in Outlook.

mechanical_plan_system_count.description: System count read off the mechanical plans. Priority 2 - only used when plans.mechanical is true.

ai_plan_review.description: Priority 3. Only used when plans.architectural is true.

notes.description: Short reasoning. Rendered into the email so the estimator can sanity-check the recommendation.

manual_j.description: Envelope specs the builder actually supplied. Any key from defaults.json manual_j_defaults: house_direction, attic_insulation, walls, roof_type, windows, foundation, duct_location. Supplied values are HIGH confidence and beat both profile overrides and Ryan OS defaults.

explicit.description: Things the builder stated in writing. These carry HIGH confidence, so only fill them in when the email genuinely says so.

deadline.description: Any stated due date. Sets the RUSH subject prefix.

notes.description: Anything the agent wants to pass to a human. Not rendered into the email.
